item.text:
Verdict: mostly no. I found a limited set of universal, rule-based benefit programs, but the stronger 2023 evidence shows Putin’s state using schooling, occupied-territory spending, and entry rules to extract loyalty and punish deviation.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Con | `Putin teaches Russian students about Soviet era, Ukraine invasion` | The Washington Post | 2023-09-01 | https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2023/09/01/putin-russia-school-militarization/ | Putin said Moscow would spend $19.8 billion in occupied Ukraine “to make people feel part of a big country and experience the advantages,” tying public investment and services to political integration and loyalty in occupied territory. | `6B.7` |
| Con | `Freedom in the World 2023: Russia` | Freedom House | 2023 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2023 | Freedom House says schools were ordered to run patriotic-education classes and military-training directives, and educators who dissented were fined or dismissed. That turns a public service system into a loyalty-enforcement channel. | `6B.7` |
| Con | `Russia is preparing a 'loyalty agreement' requirement for foreigners` | Reuters | 2023-11-29 | https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/draft-bill-seeks-loyalty-agreement-from-foreigners-entering-russia-3252165 | Russia prepared a loyalty agreement for foreigners that would bar criticism of official policy and other disfavored speech, making access to entry/permission conditional on political conformity. | `6B.7` |
| Con | `Putin tells Russia's billionaires to put patriotism before profit` | Reuters | 2023-03-16 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/putin-urges-russias-billionaires-to-invest-in-face-of-sanctions-war-3032372 | Putin told business elites their role was not just to make money but to support society and the state. This is not a welfare program, but it is explicit loyalty framing around economic activity. | `6B.7` |
| Pro | `Parents receive children's payments from the Social Fund on a single day of delivery of benefits` | Social Fund of Russia | 2023-01-25 | https://sfr.gov.ru/en/press_center/~2023/01/25/250437 | Child payments were centralized onto a fixed monthly delivery date, which is rule-based administration rather than obviously selective or loyalty-conditioned welfare. | `6B.7; 6B.5` |
| Pro | `More than a million families received a one-time payment at the birth of a child last year` | Social Fund of Russia | 2023-01-25 | https://sfr.gov.ru/en/press_center/~2023/01/25/250435 | The birth allowance was due to all Russian families regardless of income or employment status, and was centralized through the Social Fund. This is the clearest counterexample to blanket loyalty-based welfare allocation. | `6B.7; 6B.5` |
| Pro | `News - The Russian Government` | Government of the Russian Federation | 2024-01-? retrospective on 2023 | https://government.ru/en/news/51246/ | The government said nearly 3,000 school buses were delivered and all primary pupils received free hot meals. The package is universal in design, though the source is official self-report and not an independent audit. | `6B.7` |

Search gap: I did not find strong 2023 evidence that ordinary nationwide cash benefits, housing, or jobs were broadly withheld or granted as explicit patronage tools. The clearest loyalty conditioning appears in education, occupied territories, and entry/permission rules, while routine family benefits were mostly presented as universal and standardized.
